questions.questionTextEn:
Consider the following statements regarding the phenomenon of El Niño and Indian Summer Monsoon rainfall:
1. El Niño involves anomalous warming of sea-surface waters in the central and eastern equatorial Pacific Ocean off the coast of Peru.
2. Strong El Niño episodes weaken the Walker Circulation and generally suppress southwest monsoon rainfall over India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.questionTextHi:
[UPPCS प्रारंभिक परीक्षा सामान्य अध्ययन-I (GS-I) • UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I]
प्रश्न (हिंदी संस्करण): निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए regarding the phenomenon of El Niño and Indian Summer मानसून वर्षा:
1. El Niño involves anomalous warming of sea-surface waters in the central and eastern equatorial प्रशांत महासागर off the coast of पेरू.
2. Strong El Niño episodes weaken the Walker Circulation and generally suppress southwest मानसून वर्षा over भारत.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explanationEn: El Niño warms the eastern equatorial Pacific off Peru/Ecuador, shifting atmospheric convection eastward, weakening the Walker cell, and causing deficient monsoon rainfall in India.
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक उत्तर एवं व्याख्या (UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I): सही विकल्प (A) है।
विस्तृत हिंदी विवरण:
El Niño warms the eastern equatorial Pacific off Peru/Ecuador, shifting atmospheric convection eastward, weakening the Walker cell, and causing deficient monsoon rainfall in India.

optionsEn: Streams that disappear underground in the porous pebble-strewn Bhabar belt re-emerge on the surface in the marshy Terai belt
The Terai belt is composed exclusively of coarse boulders with zero surface water
The Bhabar belt is highly marshy and ideal for paddy and sugarcane cultivation
The Terai belt lies south of the Vindhyan scarpland

विकल्प: The Terai belt lies south of the Vindhyan scarpland

[UPPCS प्रारंभिक परीक्षा सामान्य अध्ययन-I (GS-I) • UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I]

optionsEn: The Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Vice-President of India)
optionsHi: विकल्प: The Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha (Vice-राष्ट्रपति of भारत)

आधिकारिक उत्तर एवं व्याख्या (UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I): सही विकल्प (A) है।
विस्तृत हिंदी विवरण:
Under Article 118(4) and the Rules of Procedure, if both the Speaker and Deputy Speaker of the Lok Sabha are absent, the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha presides over a Joint Sitting (never the Chairman/Vice-President, as he is not a member of either House).

questions.questionTextEn: Why does total internal reflection occur in optical fibers used for high-speed telecommunications?
questions.questionTextHi:
[UPPCS प्रारंभिक परीक्षा सामान्य अध्ययन-I (GS-I) • UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I]
प्रश्न (हिंदी संस्करण): Why does total internal reflection occur in optical fibers used for high-speed telecommunications?
optionsEn: Light travels inside a higher-refractive-index glass core (n1) surrounded by a lower-refractive-index cladding (n2 < n1) at an angle of incidence greater than the critical angle θ_c
The outer cladding has a much higher refractive index than the inner core
Light undergoes diffraction through metallic mirrors coated inside the core
The speed of light becomes infinite inside the silica core
optionsHi: विकल्प: Light travels inside a higher-refractive-index glass core (n1) surrounded by a lower-refractive-index cladding (n2 < n1) at an angle of incidence greater than the critical angle θ_c
विकल्प: The outer cladding has a much higher refractive index than the inner core
विकल्प: Light undergoes diffraction through metallic mirrors coated inside the core
विकल्प: The speed of light becomes infinite inside the silica core
questions.explanationEn: Optical fibers rely on Total Internal Reflection (TIR), requiring n_core > n_cladding and incidence angle θ_i > arcsin(n_cladding / n_core).
questions.explanationHi:
आधिकारिक उत्तर एवं व्याख्या (UPPCS Prelims • 2023 • GS-I): सही विकल्प (A) है।
विस्तृत हिंदी विवरण:
Optical fibers rely on Total Internal Reflection (TIR), requiring n_core > n_cladding and incidence angle θ_i > arcsin(n_cladding / n_core).

Excess nitrate (NO3⁻ > 45 mg/L) in drinking water is reduced to nitrite in an infant's gut, oxidizing hemoglobin (Fe²⁺) to methemoglobin (Fe³⁺), which cannot transport oxygen (Blue Baby Syndrome).
